native_2x_registration.method: Each opaque source pixel compared against every pixel in its exact 2x2 native-render block, excluding a courier rectangle only.

approaches.note: Branch is an outdoor clerk interaction, not an enterable hall gate.

shared_repository_snapshot.classification: Other observed changes are outside this room/approach verification and are not attributed to this verifier; concurrent creature/battle/effect work is preserved, never restored.

observations: Room furniture, quilt folds/stitches, stove seams/woodpile, cupboard/coat folds and shelf items read at actual 2x without apparent clipping or foreground registration seams. Worktable remains clear.
Original pale cloth plane is visible beside the coat. The cabinet upper section fades around both courier models; its lower base remains solid and the courier is readable behind it.
COURIER HALL and COURIER BRANCH labels are clear above the roofs. Both final approaches visually meet the building front and continue into their existing roads in the full native map captures.
Focused building captures deliberately crop the surrounding approach road; full hometown/riverfront captures establish the joins.
limits: The final ordinary-input proof covers two cached home visits per model; it does not rerun the original full delivery journey or ordinary entry to the courier hall in this phase.

The overview uses independent initial-area diagnostic cameras. Its 11 explicit target checks cover four room sprites and seven building sprites; the two new approach sprites are verified separately by current-source crop/placement checks and the saved native images.
Shared repository changes outside the verified scope are reported separately; no global unchanged-repository assertion is made.

import_notes.import_warnings: Both headless imports report boot-time filesystem snapshot and settled imports, then one CanvasItem RID and three ObjectDB exit leak warnings. These import shutdown warnings are distinct from the three empty native runtime stderr logs.
